newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end firmer, Bund spreads steady.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end firmer, Bund spreads steady.

text.p: 1623 GMT - Portuguese bond futures ended firmer and cash was well-supported, with spreads against 10-year Bunds steady at just above 50 basis points (bps), dealers said.
*Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -12 bps vs -17 bps cls
Portuguese bonds closed well-supported despite the drop of U.S. Treasuries and the proximity of the second round of French legislative elections.

Dealers said they expected yield spreads against 10-year Bunds to remain steady tomorrow. They added that this record low spread was likely to remain in place while optimism persisted over Portugal's chances of joining Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) from the start.
"If peripheral markets retain their force, June futures will test 109.25, the nearest resistance level. To reach 109.50 will be very difficult," a futures dealer said.
Another dealer said: "As each day passes, the yield spread against Bunds is consolidating around 50 basis points. It is a very strong bet that Portugal will join EMU in 1999."
A fixed income analyst said: "50 bps will be the reference spread while this optimism (over Portugal's entry to EMU) persists."
